question: Does the frozen never-served assertion model reproduce on the fresh provenance block: does loop formation dominate, and are the rank and count associations in the same direction, with seed held fixed?
scope: Six seeds already used for the provenance replication, one compositional world family, 120 cycles and cap 40. This is a replication on that existing fresh block, not a new independent seed draw.

design.world: generate_compositional_world(seed=, cycles=120) with the PHASE_ACQUISITION schedule and one replay per seed
design.population: every world edge with zero direct served windows
design.rank: minimum 1-based position in the repaired observer's full pre-cap universe across all 120 cycles; the served window remains the engine's own cap-40 list
design.loop: ever_loop: at least one reported loop_candidate path contains the edge in either orientation in any cycle
design.count: final direct temporal transition count from service._load_temporal
design.replay: One replay per seed. The repaired observer's second call records the full universe without changing the served list.
design.freshness_note: These six seeds already carry ASSERTION-PROVENANCE-REPLICATION-1. They are fresh relative to the Q4 model, but this is a replication on that existing fresh block, not a new independent seed draw.

model.formula: logit P(asserted) = b0 + b_loop*loop + b_rank*z(log2(min_rank)) + b_count*z(direct_count) + seed fixed effects
model.estimator: Firth penalized likelihood (Jeffreys prior), fixed before the fit, because the original model had an empty no-loop asserted cell
model.convergence: max absolute Newton step < 1e-8, at most 200 iterations

inference.primary: Firth Wald 95% intervals for loop, rank and count
inference.odds_ratios: loop is 0/1; rank and count are per 1 SD. A rank OR below 1 means a worse rank is associated with lower assertion.
inference.sensitivity: leave-one-seed-out refits with the same model; no cluster-robust SE claim is made.
inference.multiplicity: one model, three reported coefficients; unadjusted
inference.no_causal_claim: The model is descriptive; no coefficient is read as a causal effect.

gates.M1_population: at least one never-served edge and one event; no duplicate seed-edge rows
gates.M2_rank_coverage: at least 95% of never-served edges have a finite minimum rank
gates.M3_provenance_replay: per-seed asserted and never-served-asserted counts match the provenance replication
gates.M5_convergence: the Firth fit converges with finite coefficients and information
gates.M6_complete_predictors: every fitted row has loop, rank and count; no silent row loss
gates.M7_seed_levels: all six seeds contribute rows and the seed fixed effect is full rank

not_evidence: A six-seed replication on one synthetic world family. The seeds were already used for the provenance split, so this is not a new independent draw. It does not establish causation, capability, retention or a general engine property.

identity_adjustment.question: Does the count association remain once source and target identity are held fixed by categorical fixed effects?
identity_adjustment.reading: The count point estimate does not attenuate when source and target identity enter, but its interval still includes 1 and the identity model is saturated in sample. This is a robustness check on an association that was already null, not evidence of a count effect.
